# Setup Node

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Set up Node with pnpm/npm/yarn/bun auto-detection, caching, and dependency install

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/setup-node@v1
```

## How it works

Node toolchain setup with package-manager auto-detection and a dependency install.

One action instead of the four-step setup-pnpm / setup-node / install dance that gets
copy-pasted into every job. It detects pnpm / yarn / npm / bun from the lockfile, wires
up the right dependency cache, and installs with the correct frozen-lockfile flag.

The dependabot nuance is built in: Dependabot regenerates lockfiles, so a frozen install
fails on its PRs. `frozen-lockfile: auto` (the default) relaxes the flag for
`dependabot[bot]` and keeps it strict for everyone else.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node-version` | no | `22` | Node version, or a path-independent spec like `lts/*`. Ignored if `node-version-file` resolves. |
| `node-version-file` | no | `""` | Read the version from this file instead (`.nvmrc`, `.node-version`, `package.json`). Empty to ignore. |
| `package-manager` | no | `auto` | auto \| pnpm \| npm \| yarn \| bun. `auto` detects from the lockfile. |
| `pnpm-version` | no | `""` | pnpm version to install. Empty reads `packageManager` from package.json. |
| `install` | no | `true` | true to install dependencies after setup. |
| `frozen-lockfile` | no | `auto` | auto \| true \| false. `auto` means strict, except on Dependabot PRs. |
| `install-args` | no | `""` | Extra args appended to the install command. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory to run in. |
| `cache` | no | `true` | true to enable the built-in dependency cache. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `package-manager` | The resolved package manager (`pnpm`, `npm`, `yarn`, or `bun`). |
| `node-version` | The Node version actually installed. |
| `cache-hit` | Whether the dependency cache was restored (`true`/`false`). |
